notes.title: Post Master's Receives an Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Post Master's First Update is Now Available![/h1]

[b]Post Master has received its first update. The following changes have been made:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicle afternoon shifts changed to 12:00 - 18:00
[*]Day skips now occur at 19:00
[*]Minor Bugfixes to both PC and Mac versions
[/list]
